items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: Well back to Happy Shilling. Lefty and, what did Frisco play?

ctx.x: He played piano, played trombone, played the cornet. He died. He worked with Bobby, died. Yeah.
Well back to Happy Shilling. Lefty and, what did Frisco play? Drones. Drones.
